# Point B

> > Point B is a management consulting firm specializing in digital transformation, data strategy, and AI-powered solutions across diverse industries.

Point B helps enterprise clients navigate digital modernization, cloud migration, and AI adoption. The firm serves Fortune 500 companies across aerospace, automotive, financial services, healthcare, retail, and other sectors with expertise in data analytics, process automation, and technology transformation.

## Key Topics

- Digital Transformation
- Data & Analytics
- Artificial Intelligence
- Cloud Migration
- Process Automation
- Hybrid Cloud
- Customer Experience
- Supply Chain
- ESG & Sustainability
- Talent Strategy
- Operations Modernization
- Employee Engagement
- Technology Modernization
- DevOps
- Strategic Assessments

- [How We Help](https://www.pointb.com/How-we-help): Point B's core consulting service areas and transformation solutions

- [Digital & Tech Transformation](https://www.pointb.com/How-we-help/Digital-Tech-Transformation): Sustainable technology modernization and digital transformation strategy
- [Hybrid Cloud](https://www.pointb.com/How-we-help/Hybrid-Cloud): Cloud strategy, security, and operational efficiency solutions
- [Process Automation](https://www.pointb.com/How-we-help/Process-Automation): Efficiency and cost reduction through intelligent process automation
- [Digital Products](https://www.pointb.com/How-we-help/Digital-Products): AI-powered digital product design and innovation solutions

- [Managed Service PMO](https://www.pointb.com/How-we-help/Managed-Service-PMO): Project management expertise for enterprise application rollouts
